lens: Geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then artefacts. Fabrics judged as photo-vs-render crops at matched physical scale (17 in = 0.43 m seat back width; q15 hero backs ~210 px vs y_47300 ~130 px, render crops downsampled x0.62; q16 near seat vs y_47301 near seat ~1:1; e4 vs y_47306 ~1:1). Head b9489fe. Measurements: /tmp/claude-0/rater17B/ms.py (box mean, B/R, L p10/p50/p90, hf = std of L minus 5 px box blur, bright = fraction of L > 1.5 x median) and blob.py (connected bright blobs: count per 1000 px, median / p90 size). Crops: /tmp/claude-0/rater17B/z15.png (q15 s2/s3 vs y_47300 s2/s3), z16.png (q16 near seat vs y_47301 near seat). Lighting and QA camera placement noted, not scored.

issues.title: Fleck at close range: round pebble blobs instead of fine elongated petals (side effect of the larger tile)
issues.evidence: q16 near pad vs y_47301 near pad (~1:1 scale, z16.png): bright blobs 9 vs 17 per 1000 px, median 7 vs 9 px, p90 19 vs 16 px; render blobs are rounded and clump into leopard spots on the pad and back top; photo flecks are thin slivers ~1:3 aspect. Close-up e4 pad blobs 12 vs 16 per 1000 px. Row distance (q15) is now right, so do not change ground level or mean fleck coverage.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py tex_y_fleck: keep the 0.24 m tile and ground, but split each core into 2 thinner elongated flecks (aspect ~1:3, random +-30 deg about the diagonal), so count goes up ~1.8x and blob size drops ~40 % at the same area fraction (~0.13-0.15); cap any single fleck at ~0.8 cm long.

issues.title: Headrest cover tall head-on (carried, waits on user question)
issues.evidence: q15 cover ~0.6 back widths vs ~0.4 in y_47300; y_47306 shows a longer hang.
issues.fix: Per the user's answer: shorten the flap ~30 % if y_47300 is the default.

issues.title: White hood side band still ~2 cm head-on (photo ~1 cm)
issues.evidence: q15 L>170 runs 10 px at y 280-340 between s1/s2 and s3/s4 (~210 px per 0.43 m); y_47300 2-4 px at ~130 px.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: bring the fabric side panel ~1 cm further outboard at hood height or narrow the hood side wrap a further ~1 cm per side.

issues.title: Side-panel fabric smears (triplanar blend) (carried)
issues.evidence: q18 left seat side, e5 right seat side: large blurred blotches; e3 diamond stars streak.
issues.fix: Sharper triplanar blend (power ~8) for seat fabric, or loft UVs on the seat sides.

issues.title: Pad pattern pairing: photo pairs fleck backs with mosaic/tick pads and tick backs with fleck pads
issues.evidence: y_47300 s2 (fleck back) pad mosaic-tick, s3 (tick back) pad fleck; y_47301 near tick back with fleck pad. Render: fleck back with fleck pad (z15.png), and every q16 pad fleck.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econFab: give fleck-back seats a mosaic pad (keep fleck pads on tick and mosaic backs).

issues.title: Diamond ground greyish, stars soft (carried)
issues.fix: Diamond tile: B/R +0.2, L +10 %, star contrast +15 %.

issues.title: Armrest J tube thin and round vs the photo's broad flat plate
issues.evidence: e7 tube ~2.5 cm round; y_47303 support is a flat white plate ~5 cm deep tapering to the pivot.
issues.fix: Sweep a flattened profile (5 x 2 cm, tapering to 3 cm at the pivot) instead of a round tube.

issues.title: Tick stitch columns still soft at row distance
issues.evidence: q15 s1 p10/p50 0.56 vs 0.45, hf 28 vs 39 (w16 0.58 / 36 -> little change from the 1.6x column lift).
issues.fix: Darken the channel troughs ~15 % in the tick tile (or a -0.5 mip bias on that layer).

issues.title: Pillow face flat (carried)
issues.fix: Fine low-contrast weave + ~5 mm darker piped rim.

issues.title: q16 near seat fabric far too light (not scored)
issues.evidence: q16 near back #4b5a8d L50 87 B/R 1.88 vs y_47301 near #222856 L50 40 B/R 2.53; q16 near pad L50 97 vs 41. Same fabrics measure right in q15 (L50 47-49), so it is exposure / light, not material.
issues.fix: Lighting: check fill on the aisle-facing near seats in q16 (exposure ~-1 stop locally) and the grey cast.

issues.title: Camera mismatches (not scored)
issues.evidence: q15 eye lower and closer than y_47300 (210 vs 130 px backs); q16 looks at the row ahead, y_47301 along the aisle; q17 differs from y_47303.
issues.fix: Match the cameras to the photos.
